newsitem.title: USA: Honeywell sells $550 mln notes in two-part deal.
newsitem.headline: Honeywell sells $550 mln notes in two-part deal.

text.p: The following two-tranche debt issue from Honeywell Inc was priced on Wednesday, according to co-lead manager J.P. Morgan Securities Inc.
Bear Stearns also co-managed the deal.
The second tranche of the deal was increased to $350 million from an initial size of $200 million.
Honeyell Inc is a manufacturer of home and commercial building controls, industrial process instrumentation, and space and aviation electronic systems.
